module "LayerRenamedInput.dsf"

product 0 MaterialLayer "Layers/ML_LiRenamedInput" backend=Graph
  legacy root ""
  %0 = FunctionInput(InputName="Attrs", InputType="MaterialAttributes", IsOptional=false, SortPriority=0) : material @L4:C1 "Attrs"
  %1 = Reflected[MakeMaterialAttributes](ClassSpecifier="MakeMaterialAttributes") : material @L7:C9 "Attrs"
  %2 = GetMaterialAttributes(MaterialAttributes=%0) : [BaseColor:float3, EmissiveColor:float3, Roughness:float, Normal:float3, Opacity:float, WorldPositionOffset:float3, FrontMaterial:Substrate, MaterialAttributes:material] @L15:C27 "BaseColor"
  %3 = Constant(Value=(1, 0.5, 0.25)) : float3 @L15:C44 "BaseColor"
  %4 = Multiply(%2, %3) : float3 @L15:C27 "BaseColor"
  %5 = SetMaterialAttributes(MaterialAttributes=%1, BaseColor=%4, AttributeSetTypes="[BaseColor]") : material @L4:C1
  %6 = FunctionOutput(%5, OutputName="Attrs", SortPriority=0) @L4:C1 "Attrs"
  inputs %0
  outputs %6
